reviewer_scope: Read-only bounded A review; no model calls, evaluator calls, private result reads, commits or comments. Documentation changes are suggestions pending root application before new D source freeze.

A1.scope: Exoplanets × discovery/evidence is newly occupied; existing Exoplanets/RadialVelocityPlanets is parameter_inversion and TransmissionSpectrumSpecies is substance. This is domain/form coverage, not proof of difficulty.

nearby.difference: Fixed Doppler samples produce a list of planet periods; this task acquires extra transit timings and returns one declared timing-family label plus forecast. RV aliases and false planet claims differ from unsupported timing-family rejection.
Poisson mass-window global significance and flat-background checks; this task uses timed residual fits with an acquisition budget.
Pulsar-pair angular kernels distinguish a background from spatial alternatives; this task uses one sequence of transit numbers and predicts an offset.

A2.repair: Existing Task.md names the first two. Describe physical family labels as laboratory assumptions rather than uniquely identified causes.

A4.scope_gap: Two current citations support gravitationally perturbed transit times but do not document the activity nuisance surrogate or clock time-error model. Current novelty risk says physically unsupported/non-identifiable, which overstates a frozen synthetic-family exclusion.
A4.adequate_bounded_claim_after_repair: Attribution within the declared synthetic timing families; model-family discrimination and forecasting, not real-star causal identification or planet mass/orbit measurement.

model_sources.supports: Analytic sinusoidal TTV family near resonance; Section 2
model_sources.does_not_establish: General physical uniqueness of a sinusoid or fitted period as orbital period.

model_sources.supports: Spot occultations can bias inferred transit timings.
model_sources.does_not_establish: Fixed secondary-period/amplitude/phase law. It must remain an explicitly phenomenological nuisance surrogate.

model_sources.supports: Constant frequency offset and linear frequency drift integrate into linear/quadratic timing deviation.
model_sources.does_not_establish: Specific synthetic coefficients, noise values or clock provenance.

A1.scope: Gravitation × discovery/parameter_inversion is newly occupied; PTAHellingsDowns occupies discovery/evidence.

nearby.difference: Measures angular correlations of many pulsars and claims a spatial kernel; this task fits a single waveform in two synthetic detectors and returns continuous parameters.
A fixed Doppler series contains planet/activity/alias periods; this task buys paired-detector samples and distinguishes coherent phase evolution from detector-localized signal.

Transit residuals with four future queries and a forecast; this task estimates two-channel transient frequency/slope/event time/amplitude with 24 measurements. Shared paid model selection is not the same physical observation family.

A2.repair: Task.md names PTA but only refers generically to microlensing. Name an actual repository neighbor, e.g. RadialVelocityPlanets, instead of implying an unnamed admitted microlensing task.

definite_error.actual_title: Binary Black Hole Mergers in the First Advanced LIGO Observing Run
